data.text:
BUS CATCHES FIRE ALONG EDSA 

A bus caught fire along EDSA-Ortigas flyover on Friday at 6:10PM, Metropolitan Manila Development Authority reported. 

"Vehicular fire involving a bus at EDSA-Ortigas Flyover southbound as of 6:10 PM. Two lanes are temporarily closed to traffic. Motorists are advised to take the service road as an alternate route. MMDA enforcers and firefighters are on site," MMDA wrote in a Facebook post. (Facebook/MMDA)
